site.name: Robertson Hall, Princeton
site.locationNote: Location supplied by Oliver, with one approximate phone GPS tag. Exact surveyed path, property boundary and per-defect positions are not yet verified.

analysis.method: AI visual proposals followed by forward/backward-checked optical-flow tracking and visual contact-sheet review. Local preprocessed analysis; no live inference.
analysis.model: Codex assistant vision (exact model build not exposed)
analysis.note: Three distinct cross-path findings selected from the full clip. Ordinary control joints excluded. All priorities and treatment options are provisional. Dimensions, damage cause, route passability and ADA compliance were not inferred.

sources.title: U.S. Access Board: ADA Accessibility Standards
sources.scopeNote: Sections 302/303/403 are technical references for campus-path inspection. Site applicability and measurements require review; no overall compliance determination.

sources.title: FHWA Guide for Maintaining Active Transportation Infrastructure
sources.scopeNote: Treatment options depend on observed failure mode, movement, level change and underlying cause. Not a site-specific repair design.

sources.title: Palmyra road program bid tabulation, March 24, 2026
sources.scopeNote: Page 1, alternate A1.6: four-inch concrete sidewalk, 20 SY, first four bids $75-$223/SY. Selected published bidder range, not all bids or a small campus-job quote. Removal, base remediation and minimum mobilization are not assumed included.

sources.title: NJDOT contract 21132 concrete joint/crack sealing benchmark
sources.scopeNote: Item 0083 / 456006M, concrete pavement joint/crack cleaning and sealing, 200 LF: page 74 selected bidders 4/5 at $18 and $59.75/LF. This is a selected reference range, not the full spread; page 12 other bidders are $20/$3.35/$74. Historical roadway work, not a 2026 sidewalk quote; no inflation adjustment or small-job minimum inferred.

findings.label: Defect 01
findings.description: An irregular crack crosses the walking panel, with a visibly broken/open edge toward the left. The opening and any vertical displacement need measurement.

review.note: Proposed from the actual footage; human field review and measurements pending.

assessment.rationale: Provisional inspection/repair priority based on visible irregular edges crossing the walking line; not a measured hazard or ADA finding.
accessImpacts: The open, irregular edge may interrupt smooth travel for small wheelchair or walker wheels.
Uneven footing or a cane-tip catch is possible; the video does not establish the opening or level difference.
measurementNeeds: Measure opening width at the widest point.
Measure vertical level difference and edge stability.
Record affected area, remaining clear width and running/cross slope.

checks.note: Opening width and orientation are unmeasured.
No vertical displacement measurement or scale is available.
Clear width, running slope and cross slope were not measured.

findings.label: Defect 02
findings.description: A transverse defect near the panel boundary includes a branching fragment on the right. This may be localized edge deterioration; depth, movement and level difference are unmeasured.

review.note: Proposed from the actual footage; human field review and measurements pending.

assessment.rationale: Provisional inspection/repair priority based on visible irregular edges crossing the walking line; not a measured hazard or ADA finding.
accessImpacts: A branching or loose edge may affect wheel contact and stable foot placement.
Check whether the fragment moves and whether there is a continuous clear passage around it.
measurementNeeds: Measure opening width at the widest point.
Measure vertical level difference and edge stability.
Record affected area, remaining clear width and running/cross slope.

checks.note: Opening width and orientation are unmeasured.
No vertical displacement measurement or scale is available.
Clear width, running slope and cross slope were not measured.

findings.label: Defect 03
findings.description: An irregular diagonal crack crosses another walking panel. No vertical displacement is established from this view; inspect width, edge stability and movement before selecting treatment.

review.note: Proposed from the actual footage; human field review and measurements pending.

assessment.rationale: Provisional inspection/repair priority based on visible irregular edges crossing the walking line; not a measured hazard or ADA finding.
accessImpacts: A cross-path crack may affect wheel or cane contact if the opening or level difference is significant.
The visible line alone does not establish a blocked route.
measurementNeeds: Measure opening width at the widest point.
Measure vertical level difference and edge stability.
Record affected area, remaining clear width and running/cross slope.

checks.note: Opening width and orientation are unmeasured.
No vertical displacement measurement or scale is available.
Clear width, running slope and cross slope were not measured.

treatments.label: Prepare and seal suitable cracks
treatments.eligibilityNote: Conditional: only if inspection finds sound, stable edges and no level change requiring a different treatment. Sealing does not correct displacement or restore a loose fragment.

assumptions: Assumed 4-8 linear feet of treatment in this work area; this is a budget scenario, not a video measurement.
Uses a historical 2021 roadway bid range without inflation adjustment; obtain a current sidewalk quote.
exclusions: Repair of displacement, loose concrete or base failure

treatments.label: Localized edge repair after inspection
treatments.eligibilityNote: Conditional: remove unsound material and specify a compatible localized repair only after checking depth, movement and sound substrate. If not suitable, replace the panel.

cost.reason: Patch depth, preparation, materials and quantity are unknown; obtain a measured scope and current quote.

treatments.label: Replace affected concrete panel
treatments.eligibilityNote: Conditional renewal option if movement, deterioration or displacement makes localized treatment unsuitable. Verify thickness, base, drainage and finish requirements.

assumptions: Assumed 1.5-4 square yards per panel (13.5-36 square feet); not measured from the video.
Four-inch sidewalk bid item is a pricing reference, not a specified thickness for this site.
exclusions: Removal and disposal unless included in the confirmed quote
